jobs.description:

Location: PAN India

Exp: 5+ years

Mode Of Interview - F2F

Job Description

Collect and prepare data for training and evaluating multimodal foundation models. This may involve cleaning and processing text data or creating synthetic data.
Develop and optimize large-scale language models like GANs (Generative Adversarial Networks) and VAEs (Variational Autoencoders)
Work on tasks involving language modeling, text generation, understanding, and contextual comprehension.
Regularly review and fine-tune Large Language models to ensure maximum accuracy and relevance for custom datasets.
Build and deploy AI applications on cloud platforms – any hyperscaler Azure, GCP or AWS.

jobs.title: GenAI Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic Generative AI Developer
to join our Controls Technology team and support the development and integration of generative AI solutions. In this hands-on role, you will work under the guidance of senior developers and AI architects to help build retrieval-grounded, context-aware, and increasingly agentic
AI applications. You will contribute to reliable, AI-driven features while growing your expertise across the modern GenAI stack. This role focuses on applying pre-trained and hosted foundation models
— through context engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and agentic workflows — rather than training or fine-tuning models.

This is a growth-oriented role: you'll take ownership of well-scoped components, learn established patterns from senior engineers, and progressively increase your technical depth and independence.

Key Responsibilities

Assist in building and integrating generative AI applications using pre-trained and hosted foundation models (via managed GenAI APIs and open-model endpoints).
Support the implementation of context engineering workflows — assembling system instructions, retrieved knowledge, tool definitions, and conversation memory into reliable, token-efficient prompts, following established patterns.
Contribute to prompt engineering (zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, role-based prompting) for AI-powered workflows.
Help develop and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) components, including chunking, embedding, and semantic/keyword search.
Support the development of knowledge graph and Graph RAG pipelines under guidance to enable grounded, traceable responses.
Contribute to agentic workflows — helping build AI agents with tool-calling and basic planning/memory, using frameworks such as Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangGraph, or CrewAI.
Assist with integrating agents to external tools and data sources via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), with exposure to the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol.
Support the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of GenAI and agentic applications in production environments.
Perform data preprocessing, document ingestion, and basic API development for AI applications.
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to integrate AI capabilities into products.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation to ensure quality and reliability.
Stay curious about advancements in GenAI and agentic AI, and share learnings with the team.

Required Technical Skills

Proficiency in Python for GenAI development, data preprocessing, and scripting.
Solid understanding of core generative AI concepts — foundation models, LLMs, tokenization, embeddings, and context windows.
Hands-on experience with prompt engineering; foundational understanding of context engineering techniques.
Practical experience (project or professional) building RAG systems, including chunking, vector databases, and semantic search.
Familiarity with knowledge graphs and interest in Graph RAG for relationship-aware retrieval.
Exposure to agentic AI development — building tool-using agents or multi-step workflows with a framework such as Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the OpenAI Agents SDK.
Awareness of agent tooling and protocols, including tool/function calling and the Model Context Protocol (MCP); familiarity with the A2A protocol is a plus.
Basic understanding of agent harness concepts — session/state management, memory, and guardrails.
Experience consuming major GenAI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) and exposure to orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
Understanding of application deployment and containerization (Docker).
Working knowledge of version control systems (Git).
Awareness of AI compliance, data privacy, guardrails, and responsible AI principles.

Required Soft Skills

Strong teamwork and communication abilities.
Eagerness to learn new AI/GenAI and agentic technologies and frameworks.
Analytical mindset and attention to detail.
Openness to feedback, coaching, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field.
4+ years of experience with atleast 2–4 years of professional experience in software/AI development, with exposure to Generative AI and agentic AI.
Experience contributing to AI/GenAI or software projects in a collaborative team setting.
Exposure to cloud-based AI/ML environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is a plus.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Trida Labs is seeking a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to lead the technical deployment of its AI-native analytics platform within customer environments. The role combines software engineering, applied AI and client engagement.
The successful candidate will implement TridaPad, AgentSQL and the TridaPad MCP Server for enterprise customers, configure them against customer data systems, and ensure measurable business outcomes. Insights gathered from deployments will inform the company's product and AI roadmap.
About the Company:

Trida Software Labs Private Limited (Trida Labs), headquartered in Bengaluru, develops AI-native data collaboration and agentic analytics products that enable organisations to move from natural-language questions to production-ready SQL, dashboards and insights. The company's product portfolio comprises:
TridaPad
– an AI-native SQL workspace offering shared queries, governance, role-based access control, integrated visualisation and connectivity to more than 50 data sources, available as a cloud or self-hosted deployment.
AgentSQL
– an agentic analytics solution that interprets natural-language requests to generate schema-aware SQL, build dashboards and surface insights, with built-in guardrails and validation.
TridaPad MCP Server
– a Model Context Protocol server that exposes TridaPad capabilities to AI clients such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Cursor, secured through per-user authentication and SQL safety controls.

Key Responsibilities:

Platform Deployment and Integration

Deploy and configure TridaPad and the TridaPad MCP Server across customer cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premise environments using containerised infrastructure.
Integrate customer data platforms, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery and Databricks, and optimise schema mapping and query performance.
Implement authentication, role-based access control and data-security configurations in line with customer policies.

Applied AI Engineering

Configure and tune AgentSQL for each customer, including schema context, business definitions, prompt design and guardrails, to ensure accurate and safe SQL generation.
Design and implement agentic workflows that connect TridaPad MCP tools with large language model clients for reporting, alerting and self-service analytics.
Develop evaluation frameworks to measure SQL accuracy, response latency and failure patterns, and drive continuous improvement.

Customer Engagement

Conduct technical discovery sessions to translate business requirements into defined use cases and solution designs.
Deliver product demonstrations, proofs of concept and production rollouts.
Lead user onboarding and training, and prepare deployment runbooks and technical documentation.

Product Feedback

Communicate field insights, defects and feature requirements to product and engineering teams.
Contribute reusable connectors, templates and enhancements to the core platform.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree (B.Tech/B.E.) in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
Strong proficiency in Python, including the development of RESTful services using FastAPI or equivalent frameworks.
Sound knowledge of SQL, including joins, window functions, common table expressions and query optimisation.
Practical experience developing applications with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Working knowledge of Docker, Linux and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience building or integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or developing AI agents using Claude, LangChain, LangGraph or similar frameworks.
Exposure to text-to-SQL systems or semantic layers such as dbt, LookML or Cube.
Familiarity with cloud data warehouses, including Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks or Redshift.
Experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLM output quality.
Working knowledge of Next.js, React or TypeScript.
Relevant industry certifications in AI platforms or cloud technologies.
Prior experience in client-facing, consulting or solutions engineering roles.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We're looking for a Software Engineer for our data pipeline service to build and work on the data pipeline that moves data from various sources to the data warehouse.The work is very diverse — all the way from patching software to building connectors to optimizing the behavior of sync services operating on our global Kubernetes compute cluster. You'll also be responsible for ensuring the technical excellence of your team and owned services, by reviewing code, contributing to architectural designs, and mentoring your junior colleagues.

This is a full-time position based out of our Bengaluru office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration.

Technologies You'll Use

Java, SQL, Mockito, WireMock, Postgres, REST API, SOAP API, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP, Azure, BuildKite, Grafana

What You'll Do

Work on core features of the product
Write connectors to integrate with source systems
Contribute to feature enhancements and bug fixes
Understand and fix challenges related to performance and scalability
Participate periodically in on-call rotation
Make Fivetran the most reliable and secure component of our customers' data infrastructure

Skills We're Looking For

Strong technical and problem-solving skills with 3+ years of professional experience writing code in the production environment
Experience in reliable distributed systems, with an emphasis on high-volume data management platforms that operate under strict SLAs
Demonstrated ability to write well-structured and performant code
Ability to design software solutions that satisfy project requirements
Expertise in working with Java, popular Cloud platforms, Cloud-based APIs, and databases
Can troubleshoot problems with existing code
Comfortable using AI coding assistants (e.g., Copilot, Claude Code, Codex) to accelerate feature development, testing, and debugging.
Knowledge of observability tools like New Relic/Grafana is a plus

Bonus Skills

Experience in data processing (ETL, ELT) and/or cloud-based platforms
Experience with OAuth, webhooks, or rate-limited third-party APIs

Perks and Benefits

100% employer-paid medical insurance*
Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
RSU stock grants*
Professional development and training opportunities
Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
Monthly cell phone stipend
Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.
May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We're honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we're proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

jobs.title: AI Native Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an AI-Native Software Engineer to help transform our software development process into an AI-first engineering model. In this role, you will use AI tools as a primary development partner to convert requirements into working software solutions faster, while maintaining strong responsibility for quality, correctness, security, and production readiness.

You will be expected to take business and technical requirements, create precise prompts and implementation plans, generate a significant portion of the initial solution using AI, and then carefully validate the output for hallucinations, prompt accuracy, missing logic, incorrect assumptions, and alignment with expected outcomes. The goal is not simply to generate code quickly, but to deliver reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software using AI as an accelerator.

The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience using AI tools for coding, design, testing, documentation, debugging, and refactoring. You should be comfortable working with ambiguity, breaking down requirements into AI-executable tasks, reviewing AI-generated code, and taking full ownership of the final solution.

Responsibilities

Use AI-assisted development tools to generate, test, document, refactor, and improve software solutions.
Convert product and business requirements into clear technical prompts, implementation plans, and acceptance criteria.
Generate 80–90% of initial solution drafts using AI tools, then review, validate, and refine the output.
Detect and correct AI hallucinations, inaccurate assumptions, invalid code, security issues, and gaps in requirements.
Create automated tests to verify expected behavior and business outcomes.
Ensure all AI-generated code meets company standards for architecture, security, maintainability, performance, and documentation.
Build reusable prompt templates and AI-native development workflows for common engineering tasks.
Collaborate with product, QA, DevOps, architecture, and security teams to deliver production-ready solutions.
Document prompts, assumptions, validation steps, risks, and final implementation decisions.
Help educate and guide other engineers in adopting AI-native software development practices.

Requirements

Strong software engineering background with experience building production-grade applications.
Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages.
Experience using AI coding tools or large language models for software development.
Strong understanding of APIs, databases, cloud services, testing, CI/CD, and secure coding practices.
Ability to write precise prompts and evaluate AI-generated outputs critically.
Strong debugging, testing, code review, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to identify hallucinations, incorrect logic, missing edge cases, and gaps between generated code and requirements.
Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Strong sense of ownership for final deliverables, regardless of whether the initial code was AI-generated.

Preferred Experience

Experience with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Amazon Q Developer, or similar tools.
Experience creating prompt libraries, AI development workflows, or internal engineering automation.
Experience with LLM applications, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, or workflow orchestration.
Experience leading process transformation or helping engineering teams adopt new development practices.
Knowledge of AI governance, data privacy, security, and responsible AI usage.

What We Expect From This Role

This role is designed for an engineer who can operate in a future-facing development model. You will not only write code; you will design the way software is created with AI. You will be responsible for accelerating delivery while ensuring that every final output is correct, tested, secure, and aligned with business expectations.

We are looking for an enthusiastic Generative AI Developer
to join our Controls Technology team and support the development and integration of generative AI solutions. In this hands-on role, you will work under the guidance of senior developers and AI architects to help build retrieval-grounded, context-aware, and increasingly agentic
AI applications. You will contribute to reliable, AI-driven features while growing your expertise across the modern GenAI stack. This role focuses on applying pre-trained and hosted foundation models
— through context engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and agentic workflows — rather than training or fine-tuning models.

This is a growth-oriented role: you'll take ownership of well-scoped components, learn established patterns from senior engineers, and progressively increase your technical depth and independence.

Key Responsibilities

Assist in building and integrating generative AI applications using pre-trained and hosted foundation models (via managed GenAI APIs and open-model endpoints).
Support the implementation of context engineering workflows — assembling system instructions, retrieved knowledge, tool definitions, and conversation memory into reliable, token-efficient prompts, following established patterns.

Help develop and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) components, including chunking, embedding, and semantic/keyword search.

Contribute to agentic workflows — helping build AI agents with tool-calling and basic planning/memory, using frameworks such as Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangGraph, or CrewAI.
Assist with integrating agents to external tools and data sources via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), with exposure to the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol.
Support the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of GenAI and agentic applications in production environments.
Perform data preprocessing, document ingestion, and basic API development for AI applications.
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to integrate AI capabilities into products.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation to ensure quality and reliability.
Stay curious about advancements in GenAI and agentic AI, and share learnings with the team.

Required Technical Skills

Proficiency in Python for GenAI development, data preprocessing, and scripting.
Solid understanding of core generative AI concepts — foundation models, LLMs, tokenization, embeddings, and context windows.
Hands-on experience with prompt engineering; foundational understanding of context engineering techniques.
Practical experience (project or professional) building RAG systems, including chunking, vector databases, and semantic search.
Familiarity with knowledge graphs and interest in Graph RAG for relationship-aware retrieval.
Exposure to agentic AI development — building tool-using agents or multi-step workflows with a framework such as Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the OpenAI Agents SDK.

Working knowledge of version control systems (Git).
Awareness of AI compliance, data privacy, guardrails, and responsible AI principles.

Strong teamwork and communication abilities.
Eagerness to learn new AI/GenAI and agentic technologies and frameworks.
Analytical mindset and attention to detail.
Openness to feedback, coaching, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field.
4+ years of experience with atleast 2–4 years of professional experience in software/AI development, with exposure to Generative AI and agentic AI.
Experience contributing to AI/GenAI or software projects in a collaborative team setting.
Exposure to cloud-based AI/ML environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is a plus.

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Trida Labs is seeking a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to lead the technical deployment of its AI-native analytics platform within customer environments. The role combines software engineering, applied AI and client engagement.
The successful candidate will implement TridaPad, AgentSQL and the TridaPad MCP Server for enterprise customers, configure them against customer data systems, and ensure measurable business outcomes. Insights gathered from deployments will inform the company's product and AI roadmap.
About the Company:

Trida Software Labs Private Limited (Trida Labs), headquartered in Bengaluru, develops AI-native data collaboration and agentic analytics products that enable organisations to move from natural-language questions to production-ready SQL, dashboards and insights. The company's product portfolio comprises:
TridaPad
– an AI-native SQL workspace offering shared queries, governance, role-based access control, integrated visualisation and connectivity to more than 50 data sources, available as a cloud or self-hosted deployment.
AgentSQL
– an agentic analytics solution that interprets natural-language requests to generate schema-aware SQL, build dashboards and surface insights, with built-in guardrails and validation.
TridaPad MCP Server
– a Model Context Protocol server that exposes TridaPad capabilities to AI clients such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Cursor, secured through per-user authentication and SQL safety controls.

Key Responsibilities:

Platform Deployment and Integration

Deploy and configure TridaPad and the TridaPad MCP Server across customer cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premise environments using containerised infrastructure.
Integrate customer data platforms, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery and Databricks, and optimise schema mapping and query performance.
Implement authentication, role-based access control and data-security configurations in line with customer policies.

Applied AI Engineering

Configure and tune AgentSQL for each customer, including schema context, business definitions, prompt design and guardrails, to ensure accurate and safe SQL generation.
Design and implement agentic workflows that connect TridaPad MCP tools with large language model clients for reporting, alerting and self-service analytics.
Develop evaluation frameworks to measure SQL accuracy, response latency and failure patterns, and drive continuous improvement.

Customer Engagement

Conduct technical discovery sessions to translate business requirements into defined use cases and solution designs.
Deliver product demonstrations, proofs of concept and production rollouts.
Lead user onboarding and training, and prepare deployment runbooks and technical documentation.

Product Feedback

Communicate field insights, defects and feature requirements to product and engineering teams.
Contribute reusable connectors, templates and enhancements to the core platform.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree (B.Tech/B.E.) in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
Strong proficiency in Python, including the development of RESTful services using FastAPI or equivalent frameworks.
Sound knowledge of SQL, including joins, window functions, common table expressions and query optimisation.
Practical experience developing applications with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Working knowledge of Docker, Linux and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience building or integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or developing AI agents using Claude, LangChain, LangGraph or similar frameworks.
Exposure to text-to-SQL systems or semantic layers such as dbt, LookML or Cube.
Familiarity with cloud data warehouses, including Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks or Redshift.
Experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLM output quality.
Working knowledge of Next.js, React or TypeScript.
Relevant industry certifications in AI platforms or cloud technologies.
Prior experience in client-facing, consulting or solutions engineering roles.

new_jobs.title: AI Native Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an AI-Native Software Engineer to help transform our software development process into an AI-first engineering model. In this role, you will use AI tools as a primary development partner to convert requirements into working software solutions faster, while maintaining strong responsibility for quality, correctness, security, and production readiness.

You will be expected to take business and technical requirements, create precise prompts and implementation plans, generate a significant portion of the initial solution using AI, and then carefully validate the output for hallucinations, prompt accuracy, missing logic, incorrect assumptions, and alignment with expected outcomes. The goal is not simply to generate code quickly, but to deliver reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software using AI as an accelerator.

The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience using AI tools for coding, design, testing, documentation, debugging, and refactoring. You should be comfortable working with ambiguity, breaking down requirements into AI-executable tasks, reviewing AI-generated code, and taking full ownership of the final solution.

Responsibilities

Use AI-assisted development tools to generate, test, document, refactor, and improve software solutions.
Convert product and business requirements into clear technical prompts, implementation plans, and acceptance criteria.
Generate 80–90% of initial solution drafts using AI tools, then review, validate, and refine the output.
Detect and correct AI hallucinations, inaccurate assumptions, invalid code, security issues, and gaps in requirements.
Create automated tests to verify expected behavior and business outcomes.
Ensure all AI-generated code meets company standards for architecture, security, maintainability, performance, and documentation.
Build reusable prompt templates and AI-native development workflows for common engineering tasks.
Collaborate with product, QA, DevOps, architecture, and security teams to deliver production-ready solutions.
Document prompts, assumptions, validation steps, risks, and final implementation decisions.
Help educate and guide other engineers in adopting AI-native software development practices.

Requirements

Strong software engineering background with experience building production-grade applications.
Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages.
Experience using AI coding tools or large language models for software development.
Strong understanding of APIs, databases, cloud services, testing, CI/CD, and secure coding practices.
Ability to write precise prompts and evaluate AI-generated outputs critically.
Strong debugging, testing, code review, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to identify hallucinations, incorrect logic, missing edge cases, and gaps between generated code and requirements.
Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Strong sense of ownership for final deliverables, regardless of whether the initial code was AI-generated.

Preferred Experience

Experience with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Amazon Q Developer, or similar tools.
Experience creating prompt libraries, AI development workflows, or internal engineering automation.
Experience with LLM applications, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, or workflow orchestration.
Experience leading process transformation or helping engineering teams adopt new development practices.
Knowledge of AI governance, data privacy, security, and responsible AI usage.

What We Expect From This Role

This role is designed for an engineer who can operate in a future-facing development model. You will not only write code; you will design the way software is created with AI. You will be responsible for accelerating delivery while ensuring that every final output is correct, tested, secure, and aligned with business expectations.
